Alex: Quick async standup — kernel / batching / KV / perf bench updates.
Alex: Yesterday: landed kernel prefetch change, rebased microbatch PR, ran a KV warmup sim (~3k reqs) — saw a tail latency spike around p95.
Alex: Blocker: intermittent OOM in canary when seq_len > 1024 on quant path. Looks like eviction order race.
Priya: Re: OOM — saw one similar on staging last week. Can you paste the small log snippet?
Alex: Log snippet: ```OOM after 1245 tokens
runtime: failed allocate 8MB
kv: evict id=0x7f3a1c - free called twice?
stack: runtime->kv->prefetch->evict_loop```
Samir: Ping me the prefetch PR link when ready, will review today. Also can you run a focused bench with n=1000, seq=512, batch=8 and attach the histogram?
Alex: Will run that. Quick baseline (canary-rt): seq=512,batch=4 -> p50=18ms p95=112ms p99=240ms.
Leo: For batching experiments, try one run with batch=12 to see throughput vs p95. If p95 jumps >2x we should back off.
Maria: Scheduling a canary window at 16:30 PT to repro OOM. @bench-bot can you queue the bench job and tag it to this thread?
bench-bot: queued job id=bench-2026-07-15-1631 (seq=512,batch=8,iters=1000). ETA ~12m. Logs will be pushed to /bench/canary/bench-2026-07-15-1631.
Alex: Thanks — I'll draft a minimal eviction-order fix + unit test and push a short-lived feature flag so we can toggle on canary.
Priya: If you want, I can triage logs during the canary window and look for double-free traces.
Samir: Cool — I'll prioritize the PR review after lunch. If you see the OOM repro consistently, we should pause the rollout.
Alex: No other blockers from me. Will follow up with bench outputs and PR link once pushed. :thumbsup:
